name: Summer Day Camp counselors and Counselors in Training (Peace Neighborhood Center)
what_you_do: High school students work with Peace staff and interns as counselors at Summer Day Camp. Rising 9th graders can join as Counselors in Training.
who_can_apply: Rising 9th graders for Counselors in Training. High school students for counselor roles.
duration: Summer Youth Services runs eight weeks
deadline_text: Dates and application steps are not posted on the page.
